programmes.d: A decorated homicide detective (Steven Seagal) journeys through Memphis' depraved underworld to face off against a perverse serial killer in this action thriller.
In this twisting cop thriller, an alcoholic detective (Sylvester Stallone) is sent to a remote detox clinic after a serial killer targets his friends and family.
Motivated by victory and revenge, modern duelists John and Colt take on the underground gunfighting world. Starring Ryan Kwanten, Freida Pinto and Mickey Rourke.

A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.
When a series of deja vu events occur, a man (Danny Glover) is forced to re-examine his past and future.
An American prisoner (Dolph Lundgren, "Rocky IV") in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped American woman.
Held for ransom, a married couple’s predicament grows increasingly dire amid the discovery of betrayal and deception. Starring Nicolas Cage ("Leaving Las Vegas") and Nicole Kidman ("Moulin Rouge!").
A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.
In this thrilling crime drama, a sheriff (Scott Patterson, "Saw V") searches for his son who is accused of murder and on the run from the law.
